note: Sanctioned WPDS compositions. `signature` is the normalized component tree — it is what makes a pattern checkable rather than merely documented. A node is `[name, ...children]`; each child is either a bare component name or another node. Only design-system components appear: raw elements between them are transparent, so an intervening `<div>` never hides a match. Matching is containment, not equality — extra children are fine, and a registered child may sit anywhere beneath the root rather than as a direct sibling, because a footer recorded beside the body and a footer nested inside it are the same composition. A signature under four nodes is documentation rather than a check: `Stack(Button,Button)` describes an action bar truthfully and matches half a codebase. Entries ship without `canonical` or `import` on purpose: the real shape is project-specific, and an implementation invented here would be wrong everywhere. Fill each in from the project's own code the first time you build it — `canonical` also tells the checker which import already satisfies the pattern, so a file using the shared implementation stops being reported.

patterns.summary: Screen title with an optional description and a trailing action cluster.
patterns.use: The top of any admin screen or panel.
instead_of: An ad-hoc row Stack + heading Text + buttons rebuilt per screen

patterns.summary: Horizontal group of actions with consistent order, spacing and alignment.
patterns.use: Anywhere two or more actions sit together; primary action last.

patterns.summary: Destructive-action confirmation dialog with confirm/cancel actions.
patterns.use: Any irreversible action needing explicit consent.
instead_of: A hand-built Modal + Stack + Button pair reimplementing confirm/cancel — ConfirmDialog already does this, controlled or uncontrolled
patterns.note: @wordpress/ui ships a newer AlertDialog for exactly this case, but components/index.json marks it experimental (not yet safe alongside @wordpress/components) — do not swap to it preemptively.

patterns.summary: Modal wrapping a form, with submit and cancel in the standard position.
patterns.use: Creating or editing a record without leaving the current screen.
instead_of: Modal with an inline form and per-instance submit placement
patterns.note: @wordpress/ui's Dialog/Drawer are Modal's eventual replacements, chosen by field count/complexity (see loupe-authoring), but both are marked experimental in components/index.json — stay on Modal until that clears.

patterns.summary: Container owning the spacing, order and dismissal of a run of Notices.
patterns.use: Any screen that can show more than one notice at a time.
instead_of: Individually placed Notice components with local margins — NoticeList already takes notices + onRemove
patterns.note: @wordpress/ui ships a newer compound Notice (Root/Title/Description/Actions), but components/index.json marks it experimental — do not swap to it preemptively.

patterns.summary: Secondary panel beside a main region, with its own header and scroll area.
patterns.use: Inspector and detail views alongside a list or canvas.
instead_of: One-off panel layouts with bespoke headers

patterns.summary: Centred explanation of why a region is empty, with the action that fills it.
patterns.use: Any list, table or canvas that can legitimately have no content.
instead_of: A centred div (or hand-built Stack + Text + Button) with a paragraph and a button — EmptyState.Root/Title/Description/Actions already ships this

patterns.summary: Label, control and help text in the standard arrangement.
patterns.use: Every field in a settings or record form.
instead_of: Label/control/help rebuilt per field with a hand-built Stack — Field.Root already handles the layout, association and a11y
Fieldset.Root for a group of controls sharing one legend, instead of Field.Root per control

patterns.summary: Visually contained surface grouping related content and actions, with an optional header.
patterns.use: Any block of related content that needs a visible boundary — settings groups, list items, dashboard tiles.
instead_of: A styled div with a border/shadow rebuilt per surface

patterns.summary: Search, filters and bulk actions above a DataViews list.
patterns.use: Any DataViews surface with filtering or bulk operations.
